caption: The video captures a wide, eye-level view of a slow, glassy river fringed by dense green summer trees, with a pale rock on the left and a fallen log on the right bank. The water mirrors the leafy canopy and a bright sky, making the composition near-symmetrical. The surface keeps rippling, so the reflected trees and sky shimmer and deform rather than showing separate moving objects. In the center background a short stretch of white-water rapids flows steadily, its churning foam contrasting with the calm foreground pool. A few tiny floating leaves and specks on the near water shift only marginally, hard to tell from the play of reflections. The camera appears fixed, holding the rock, banks, and tree silhouettes in place. The scene is a quiet, ongoing flow of water and trembling mirror images.
